translations.title: Naproxen 250 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis; tendinitis and bursitis; acute gout; painful menstruation; musculoskeletal disorders such as sprains, bruises and low back pain; pain after surgery or tooth extraction; and migraine.
translations.usage: For pain, adults first take two capsules (500 mg), then one capsule (250 mg) every 6 to 8 hours, without exceeding 1,250 mg a day. If your stomach is sensitive, take it after food, and do not take it together with other anti-inflammatory painkillers.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to this medicine, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers; if you have a peptic ulcer, severe liver or kidney impairment, heart failure or bronchial asthma; for pain around coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery; if you are pregnant or breastfeeding; or if you are a child aged 2 or under. Because there is a risk of cardiovascular clots such as heart attack and stroke and of gastrointestinal bleeding or ulcers, stop taking it and seek advice if you have stomach pain, black stools, a rash or difficulty breathing.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Menstrual pain, headache, toothache, muscle pain, joint pain, low back pain
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Stomach problems, cardiovascular or kidney disease, pregnancy

translations.title: Alfacalcidol 1 μg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to improve symptoms that accompany abnormal vitamin D metabolism, such as low blood calcium and bone pain, in chronic kidney failure, hypoparathyroidism, and vitamin D–resistant rickets or osteomalacia, and for osteoporosis.
translations.usage: The dose is adjusted while your blood calcium level is kept under control. For osteoporosis or chronic kidney failure, adults take half to one capsule (0.5–1 μg) once a day. Do not take it together with products containing calcium, vitamin D or magnesium.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have high blood calcium, high blood phosphate or high blood magnesium, or signs of vitamin D toxicity. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, a child, an older adult, or have had kidney stones, talk to a pharmacist before taking it, and take care not to exceed the set dose.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies active vitamin D for calcium metabolism
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Osteoporosis; low blood calcium and bone pain from abnormal vitamin D metabolism
summaryTable.Who should be careful: High blood calcium, kidney stones, pregnancy or breastfeeding
summaryTable.Why this one: A high-strength active vitamin D preparation

translations.title: Arginine Tidiacicate 200 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used as an adjunctive treatment for impaired liver function.
translations.usage: Adults take 100–200 mg twice a day, after food.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are a child aged 15 or under, or if you have severe kidney failure. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, talk to a pharmacist before taking it, and if there is no improvement after about a month, seek advice.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Adjunctive care for impaired liver function
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Children aged 15 or under, severe kidney failure
summaryTable.Why this one: An arginine preparation used to support liver function

translations.title: Ibuprofen 400 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for fever and pain from a cold, low back pain, menstrual pain, arthritis, pain after surgery, headache, migraine, toothache, muscle pain, neuralgia and soft-tissue injury.
translations.usage: For mild to moderate pain and colds, adults take half to one capsule (200–400 mg) three to four times a day. For migraine, take half to one capsule, without exceeding 400 mg in 24 hours. Do not exceed the recommended dose.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to this medicine, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers; if you have a gastrointestinal ulcer or bleeding, severe liver or kidney impairment, heart failure, high blood pressure or bronchial asthma; for pain around CABG surgery; or during the last three months of pregnancy. Because there is a risk of cardiovascular clots and gastrointestinal bleeding, stop taking it and seek advice if you have stomach pain, black stools or difficulty breathing.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Fever, headache, migraine, toothache, menstrual pain, muscle pain, joint pain
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Stomach problems, cardiovascular or kidney disease, late pregnancy

translations.title: Clonixin Lysinate 125 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to relieve mild to moderate pain such as muscle pain, neuralgia, pain after injury or surgery, headache, toothache and earache.
translations.usage: Adults take one to two capsules (125–250 mg) three times a day. Do not take it together with other anti-inflammatory painkillers.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have a peptic ulcer; if you have ever had asthma, hives or an allergy to this medicine, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers; for pain around CABG surgery; if you are pregnant; or if you have severe liver or kidney impairment, heart failure or inflammatory bowel disease. If you have had high blood pressure, bronchial asthma, or liver or kidney impairment, talk to a pharmacist before taking it.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Muscle pain, neuralgia, headache, toothache, earache, pain after injury or surgery
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Peptic ulcer, severe liver or kidney impairment, pregnancy
summaryTable.Why this one: An anti-inflammatory painkiller for mild to moderate pain (soft capsule)

translations.title: Flubendazole 500 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to treat roundworm, pinworm, whipworm and hookworm infections, and mixed infections of these.
translations.usage: Adults and children take one tablet (500 mg) as a single dose.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to this medicine or if you are pregnant. If you are an infant under 1 year of age, a woman who may be pregnant, or breastfeeding, talk to a pharmacist before taking it. Because pinworm is easily re-transmitted within a family, it is best to treat the family together.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Roundworm, pinworm, whipworm and hookworm infection

translations.title: Ibuprofen Arginine 368.9 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, low back pain, headache, menstrual pain, anti-inflammatory pain relief after injury, and fever and pain from influenza.
translations.usage: Adults and children aged 12 and over take one to two tablets every 4 to 6 hours with water, up to a maximum of six tablets (1,200 mg as ibuprofen) a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have a peptic ulcer or a severe blood disorder; if you have ever reacted to this medicine, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers; if you have bronchial asthma; for pain around CABG surgery; if you have had a heart attack; or if you are pregnant. If you have liver or kidney impairment or heart failure, or are an older adult, talk to a pharmacist before taking it, and discuss taking it with other anti-inflammatory painkillers or anticoagulants.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Headache, menstrual pain, low back pain, arthritis, pain after injury, cold fever
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Stomach problems, cardiovascular or kidney disease, pregnancy
summaryTable.Why this one: An ibuprofen arginine salt formulated for fast absorption

translations.title: L-Cystine 500 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used as adjunctive treatment for eczema and acne, and for disorders of keratin areas where the nails and hair split easily.
translations.usage: Take two to four capsules (1,000–2,000 mg) a day for 10 to 20 days out of a month.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have severe kidney impairment or hepatic coma, if you are a child aged 6 or under, if you have cystinuria, or if you are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soy or peanut. If you have kidney stones or a disorder of fat metabolism, talk to a pharmacist before taking it, and stop if there is no improvement after a month.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies an amino acid for skin and hair
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Eczema and acne; disorders of keratin areas where nails and hair split
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Soy or peanut hypersensitivity, kidney stones
summaryTable.Why this one: An amino acid preparation involved in skin and hair
